entries.title: Cape Verde's historic World Cup ride ends after pushing Argentina to the brink

entries.title: Iran's control of the Strait of Hormuz remains a powerful bargaining chip
entries.snippet: Despite efforts by U.S. negotiators, Iran says it wants to charge a toll for ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz. It's yet another unresolved issue of the U.S.-Iran war.

entries.title: A family steps in to save the dying casino town of Primm, Nevada
entries.snippet: Primm, Nev., a once-thriving casino town on the border with California, was on the verge of fading away for good. The family it was named for has stepped in and faces the challenge of reviving it.

entries.title: The FBI is directing hundreds of analysts to its investigation of Georgia's 2020 presidential election
entries.snippet: Georgia's votes in that year's presidential race were counted three times, including once by hand, and each count affirmed Democrat Joe Biden's win.

entries.snippet: Khamenei's flag-draped coffin sat at Tehran's Grand Mosalla alongside family members killed in the Israeli airstrike that came in the first moments of the war on Feb. 28.

entries.snippet: The pontiff's trip to the migration frontline of Lampedusa underscored a stark message for Europe and the United States as intolerance and indifference rise.

entries.title: India news: Government lists 23 Pakistanis as 'terrorists'
entries.snippet: Indian government has designated 23 Pakistan-based individuals as "terrorists" under its anti-terror law. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Ukraine strikes oil terminals near St. Petersburg in Russia
entries.snippet: The long-range strikes are the latest salvo in Ukraine’s expanding campaign to inflict economic damage on Russia and hinder its war machine.

entries.title: Germany news: AfD kicks off conference amid massive protests
entries.snippet: As members of the far-right AfD party met in Erfurt, thousands of protesters were marching and blocking roads across the city. Meanwhile, firefighters were struggling to contain a major blaze in Stuttgart. DW has more.

entries.title: Australia's Great Barrier Reef again avoids 'in danger' label
entries.snippet: UNESCO acknowledged Australia's efforts towards the Great Barrier Reef's health but raised concerns over mass bleaching. For now, the popular marine site seems to have dodged the "endangered" tag.

entries.title: Trump set to put NATO unity to the test at Turkey summit
entries.snippet: NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte is working to keep the alliance united and Donald Trump engaged. But disputes over burden sharing, US military commitments, and the Iran war are creating a major test for NATO unity.

entries.title: Kielce pogrom in Poland: 80th anniversary of 1946 massacre
entries.snippet: Just over a year after World War II ended, a mob in the Polish city of Kielce killed around 40 Jews, some of them Holocaust survivors. A lie about ritual child murder escalated the violence.

entries.title: US: President Trump pardons 11 people, including Clean Air Act violators
entries.snippet: Donald Trump has granted pardons to nine people convicted of violating a key environmental law. The US President has also pardoned an associate of convicted felon and former lobbyist Jack Abramoff.

entries.title: Iran: Khamenei's funeral ceremonies officially begin
entries.snippet: Huge crowds have gathered in Tehran to pay their final respects to Iran's supreme leader, who was killed in an airstrike at the start of the US-Israeli campaign against Iran.

entries.title: Heat wave upends July Fourth celebrations across US
entries.snippet: A dangerous heat wave has disrupted July Fourth events across the United States, including Donald Trump's flagship Great American State Fair, as the nation prepares to mark its 250th birthday.

entries.title: Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce tie knot in star-studded ceremony
entries.snippet: The couple got married in a major star-studded celebration at Madison Square Garden over the Fourth of July weekend.

entries.title: NASA launches spacecraft to recover sinking telescope
entries.snippet: The Swift telescope has been affected by recent solar storms and is sinking faster than ever, heading toward Earth. A NASA mission will try to capture it and boost its orbit.

entries.title: Lyra McKee: 3 men acquitted of killing N. Irish journalist
entries.snippet: McKee was killed while covering clashes between Republicans and police in 2019. Judge Patricia Smyth said evidence was insufficient for a conviction, while McKee's family expressed disappointment.

entries.title: Maltese tycoon faces trial over Caruana Galizia murder
entries.snippet: The Maltese businessman accused of masterminding journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia’s 2017 murder is in court — seven years after his arrest. Five other men have already been found guilty for their roles in the murder.

entries.title: Pope Leo defends US immigrant history at 250th anniversary
entries.snippet: The first US pope said "successive waves of immigrants" played a role in shaping the United States, which marks its 250th anniversary on Saturday. Leo's remarks have made him a target of President Donald Trump.

entries.title: NATO summit: European members and Canada pledge long-term Ukraine aid
entries.snippet: The NATO alliance's European members and Canada have signaled a readiness to fully take over the financing of Ukraine's fight against Russia.

entries.title: EU sanctions Russian researchers involved in Navalny's death
entries.snippet: The six sanctioned Russian scientists were linked to the production of epibatidine — the deadly toxin identified in the body of Putin critic Alexei Navalny after his death.

entries.title: Germany: Merz rebukes Trump jab over defense at Baltic event
entries.snippet: In a meeting with Baltic leaders, Germany's Chancellor Friedrich Merz played up Germany's defense spending. It comes after new criticism from President Donald Trump that Germany is lagging behind other NATO allies.

entries.title: Nigeria: US pulls some troops after anti-IS operation
entries.snippet: The United States has withdrawn most of the forces it deployed for a recent operation against "Islamic State" militants in northeastern Nigeria, but it is continuing to provide intelligence support at Abuja's request.
